description: Dysflow lifecycle hooks (session-start, post-compaction, user-prompt-submit, subagent-stop, stop) — Mirror engram's hook shape but adapted to dysflow's Access/VBA domain. Namespace: dysflow-plugin. Each event handler runs `scripts/<event>.sh` from this plugin's install root.
